title: Build Workforce command shell and compatibility routing
goal: Replace the current Staff Operations shell with URL-backed workforce navigation while preserving legacy links and flag-off rollback.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Refresh, shared links, back/forward, and organization switching preserve authorized state
Mobile navigation always has visible names
Flag-off restores the current surface without losing legacy data
